description: Executable synthetic tasks reuse the cross-source snapshots. Tests establish fixture behavior, not independent product quality.

cases.task: Complete the payment adapter's retry_payment function for transient transport failures. Preserve existing deployed behavior while making repeated attempts safe; explain any policy discrepancy that needs follow-up.
critical_constraints: Reuse the exact same idempotency token for every attempt.
Retry only transient transport failures; declines propagate immediately.
Preserve the observed five-retry behavior in this narrowly scoped implementation; retain the unresolved three-retry accepted policy as an explicit follow-up.

cases.task: Complete ledger_adapter.transfer so the debit and credit are posted through the existing database interface. Handle invalid input and partial failure without leaving inconsistent balances.
critical_constraints: Use the current PostgreSQL architecture, not the obsolete MySQL recollection.
Debit and credit commit together; any partial failure rolls back.
Invalid nonpositive amounts must be rejected before any database writes.

cases.task: Complete release_gate.may_release for the production and staging artifact pipeline. Preserve the intended scope of the staging fixture exception and reject unknown environments.
critical_constraints: Production always requires a valid artifact signature.
Only staging fixtures qualify for the unsigned exception.
